Trust decision: whether the built-in debug/test HTML pages are mounted at all — set once in `configureServer` via `registerTestPages` and in `server()` via `APPIUM_ENABLE_LEGACY_TEST_PAGES`; the fix adds no escaping, it removes the default surface.
`pattern_fit`: A.
Strongest lever: the root cause (`compileLodashTemplate`, unescaped `with`/`new Function`) lives in a generic utility module far from the reported routes, while the legitimate opt-in page rendering must keep working — so an escape-the-params fix or a delete-the-templates fix both fail.
Biggest red flag: none from the list; the real risk is that the published fix leaves the injection intact behind a flag, so hidden tests must check gating, not sanitising.
